title: Omni-Reward: Towards Generalist Omni-Modal Reward Modeling with Free-Form Preferences

layout.note: Nine tinted rounded cards in two columns (five at left, four at right) of unequal heights surround a central coloured scatter cloud, each tied to it by a colour-matched dashed leader; every card repeats one template of title, query, two responses and two dashed criteria boxes.

lesson: Give every task the same card template (title, query, two responses, criteria with verdict tags), tint each card in its own colour and carry that colour to a leader line and a cluster in a central cloud, so many modalities read as one family.
